abstract_generation.system: You are a senior researcher writing a concise academic abstract.
abstract_generation.user_template: Write a 200-300 word abstract for a paper titled '{title}'. The study uses {methodology} and finds that {key_findings}. Include background, methods, results, and implications.

literature_review.system: You are a research assistant specializing in systematic literature review.
literature_review.user_template: Conduct a literature review on '{topic}'. Identify 5-10 key papers, summarize their contributions, and identify research gaps.

method_description.system: You are an experimental scientist writing a methods section.
method_description.user_template: Write a detailed methods section for an experiment involving {experiment_type}. Include equipment specifications, procedures, and data analysis methods.

discussion_synthesis.system: You are an academic researcher interpreting experimental results.
discussion_synthesis.user_template: Compare our findings ({our_results}) with existing literature ({literature_context}). Discuss implications, limitations, and future work.
